_: kogaki#1349: the Move schema's field-to-role mapping. The pipeline reads roles, never field names (specs/spec-draft-pipeline/SPEC.md field-roles table). `required` roles must be mapped by every schema; `optional` roles are null (omitted here) where a schema has nothing to map them to. A field this file does not name is carried on the record and read by nothing.

shapes._: kogaki#1414 and kogaki#1413: the shapes of the record's structured fields. A Move record is a `.yaml` file read by the Brief's YAML reader (src/yaml.mjs); the role adapter (`moveContract` in src/compose.mjs) and tools/move_ingest.py both refuse a record that does not hold these shapes. The Moves written before them are regenerated under them by kogaki#1415.
shapes.state: `before` and `after` are each a map keyed by dimension -- knowledge, question, expectation, orientation, trust -- one entry per changed dimension, each value one sentence; a state written as one joined line is refused by name (kogaki#1413)
shapes.segments: a list of maps, one per Segment, in order: `does`, the step's operation, subject-free, never its effect on the reader; and, on every Segment after the first, `relation`, its relation to the Segment before it, in prose; Segment 1 carries no relation (kogaki#1411)
shapes.breaks: a list of prose tests, one entry each: a specific change to the paragraph, a dash, what the reader loses; read whole, no keys and no fixed kinds
